portscan.name: Network Service Discovery
portscan.description: Adversaries may attempt to get a listing of services running on remote hosts and local network infrastructure devices.

beaconing.name: Application Layer Protocol
beaconing.description: Adversaries may communicate using OSI application layer protocols to avoid detection by blending in with existing traffic.

arp_spoof.name: ARP Cache Poisoning
arp_spoof.description: Adversaries may poison ARP caches to position themselves between the communication of two or more networked devices.

exfiltration.name: Exfiltration Over Alternative Protocol
exfiltration.description: Adversaries may steal data by exfiltrating it over a different protocol than that of the existing command and control channel.

dns_tunneling.name: Application Layer Protocol: DNS
dns_tunneling.description: Adversaries may communicate using the DNS application layer protocol to avoid detection.

dga.name: Domain Generation Algorithms
dga.description: Adversaries may use DGAs to dynamically establish C2 communications.

cleartext_creds.name: Credentials In Files
cleartext_creds.description: Adversaries may search local file systems and remote file shares for files containing insecurely stored credentials.

cleartext_protocol.name: Network Sniffing
cleartext_protocol.description: Adversaries may sniff network traffic to capture information including authentication material.

dhcp_rogue.name: DHCP Spoofing
dhcp_rogue.description: Adversaries may redirect network traffic to adversary-owned systems by spoofing DHCP traffic.

tls_downgrade.name: Downgrade Attack
tls_downgrade.description: Adversaries may downgrade or use a version of system features that may be outdated, vulnerable, and/or does not support updated security controls.

file_transfer_mismatch.name: Masquerading: Masquerade File Type
file_transfer_mismatch.description: Adversaries may masquerade the file type of malicious content to avoid detection.

lateral_movement_smb.name: Remote Services: SMB/Windows Admin Shares
lateral_movement_smb.description: Adversaries may use SMB to interact with a remote network share or to move laterally.

stp_attack.name: Network Boundary Bridging
stp_attack.description: Adversaries may bridge network boundaries by compromising perimeter network devices.

unusual_ja3.name: Application Layer Protocol: Web Protocols
unusual_ja3.description: Unusual TLS client fingerprint (JA3) may indicate non-standard tooling used for C2 communications.

data_encoding.name: Data Encoding
data_encoding.description: Adversaries may encode data to make network traffic appear normal.
